_about: The seasons the Season Forecast looks at. EDIT THIS FILE to change them; restart the app after. Dates of the Islamic festivals move about 11 days earlier each year and depend on moon sighting, so the dates below are APPROXIMATE (+/- 1 day): check them against the official calendar and correct them. A season has one window per year (start and end dates). 'fixed' seasons repeat on the same dates every year (give them as MM-DD); 'moving' seasons list the festival day for each year, and the window is the lead_days days up to and including that day. Only years listed here are used. The Christmas window ends on 8 December so that it fits inside the public demo data (Online Retail II), which stops on 9 December 2011; for a real shop change "end" to 12-31.
